review_candidates.title: Product Safety Certifier- EMC
review_candidates.description: Employment Status Regular Time Type Full time BUILDING A WORLD CLASS TEAM STARTS WITH YOU At the heart of CSA Group is a vision: making the world a better, safer, more sustainable place. It's been part of our mission for nearly one hundred years: from the first engineering standard for railway bridges developed in 1919, to more than 3,500 standards, codes & related products today. Headquartered in Canada, with a global footprint of more than 30 labs and offices across Europe, Asia and North America, CSA Group tests, inspects and certifies a wide range of products - from every day househould items to leading edge technology-to meet exacting requirements for safety, performance and environmental impact. Our employees take pride in making a difference in people's lives through the work that we do. We're looking for people like you to help make it happen. Job Summary PERFORMANCE Handles a narrow spectrum of projects generating moderate revenue levels Demonstrates a good understanding of the company certification process, accreditation requirements and governing quality management procedures. Demonstrates understanding of and the ability to accurately perform all elements of evaluation (contract review, evaluation and determine a test plan) under supervision. Demonstrates understanding of all elements involved in testing for specific standards (select proper tests, understand past fail criteria and rational) under supervision. Conducts construction evaluation, ensuring the unit complies with the construction section of the standard; identifies rationale for compliance or non-compliance. Collaborates with Lab Technician to create a work order which test are required and; the order of the tests and the number of samples required. Classifies product by use, environment and function. Determines the applicable requirements / test / standard. Determines sample requirements and method / location for testing evaluation best suited to customers' needs. Conducts pre-assessment with mentor assistance, of equipment to ensure the unit is equipped with the proper components and agrees with the construction indicated on the work order and submittal information. Works with mentor to ensure completion or projects within time frame deadlines. With mentor assistance, evaluates products against requirements of national and / or international standards. With assistance, prepares work orders for the test program. Works in collaboration with Lab personnel to determine applicable tests. Assists test personal and perform test when required. Prepares Findings Communications, Certification reports, Certificates of Compliance and other related CSA documentation for the mentor. CUSTOMER As appropriate, suggests to sales team new client opportunities to support growth Prepares project quotations for cost and time. Classifies product by use, environment and function. Determines applicable requirements / test / standards. With supervision, determines sample requirements and method / location for testing / evaluation best suited to customers’ needs. Explains the different product certification programs available to clients and the requirements for control of production. Provides client feedback to mentor, Manager, Team Leader, Project Holder or Sales Rep as appropriate. TESTING Performs within established DQD guidelines. Prepares Test Lab Work Orders and Special Testing Documentation. Provides necessary guidance to Lab Technicians to ensure proper application of requirements and data collections methods are in line. Set-ups and operates all test equipment within an assigned product area with supervision. Demonstrates an understanding of the test method for common tests and ability to correctly specify a test plan. Demonstrates the ability to record and report evaluation, tests and calculations capturing all relevant data required by each standard with supervision. Conducts witness test programs at manufacturer’s accredited laboratory as needed with supervision. SELF DEVELOPMENT Strives to become more knowledgeable in national / international standards through research of standards, documentation, bulletins and technical articles in area of specialty. Participates in formal, informal, and team training events to expand his / her Certifier capabilities. Seeks to understand and plan for own development needs in line with this competency matrix and the tests they are assigned to perform Performs other duties as assigned by mentor, Manager, Team Leader, or Project Manager. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on any grounds stipulated by applicable laws. We are an organization where opportunities are based on skills and abilities, and differences are respected and valued. review_candidates.description: Company Description MAASH, founded in 2021 and based in Brussels, is an innovative biotechnology company developing sustainable mycoprotein-based protein alternatives for food and feed. Through advanced fermentation processes, MAASH is helping to transform food production methods towards more sustainable solutions with a low environmental impact. The company also has an industrial site in France, located on the Carling chemical platform (Moselle), dedicated to the development and production of its innovative ingredients.   🔹 The position As the site's technical referent for production processes, you will manage the continuous improvement of our facilities, support the ramp-up of our industrial demonstrator and contribute to projects with high environmental and energy challenges. You will work in a varied environment including: • Industrial fermentation • Effluent utilities and treatment • Recycling and water management • Material and energy balances   🔹 Your first missions • Setting up and monitoring a pilot water recycling unit • Carry out the technical and economic analysis of the envisaged solution and compare it to other existing solutions on the market • Formulate recommendations for industrialization   🔹 Energy optimization • Analyze the energy consumption of the process and identify sources of savings • Propose and deploy optimization solutions (utilities, processes, energy recovery)   🔹 Commissioning of the industrial demonstrator • Supporting industrial fermentation for mycoprotein production • Monitor and improve sterility performance; strengthen CIP/SIP strategies to reduce contamination risks • Contribute to scale-ups of the Maash process • Participate in the commissioning and management of the industrial demonstrator • Be responsible for updating functional analyses and interface with the automation company or identified subcontractors to carry out PLC and DCS modifications. • Support the ramp-up and reliability of processes • Contribute to testing protocols and analysis of results • Participate in obtaining FSCC22000 certifications • Member of the HACCP team   🔹 Continuous improvement and process optimization • Promote and manage the continuous improvement approach (yield, performance, safety, quality, environment, ergonomics) • Detect, propose and implement improvement projects after validation • Carry out improvement studies, write specifications and technical specifications, participate in investment studies and validate the performance obtained   🔹 Process expertise & drift treatment • Provide technical assistance in the event of process drifts or malfunctions of installations • Search for root causes (root cause trees, FMEA) and propose preventive and corrective actions • Lead trials and verify the effectiveness of improvements in the field   🔹 Technical documentation • Create and maintain the technical documentation system (operating procedures, PID and PFD diagrams, functional analyses) • Update automation functional analyses in conjunction with the automation engineer and/or subcontractors • Maintain the plant's analytical control plan   🔹 Production monitoring & field support • Participate in the monitoring of production compliance and the development of the factory balance sheet (material and energy balances) • Animate the visual management and keep the indicators up to date • Support and train production teams (training materials, skills matrices)   🔹 Your profile You hold a Bac +5 level diploma (engineer) in biological engineering, process engineering or equivalent A first experience in the process industry (chemical, agri-food, biotechnology, energy or water treatment), experience on a production site is highly appreciated Ideally, you have knowledge in the following areas: • Process engineering and material/energy balances • Water treatment and recycling, effluent and utility management • Energy efficiency • Techno-economic analysis and investment studies • Reading and updating PID/PFD schematics • Continuous improvement methods and FMEA • Knowledge of bioprocess is a plus · Bilingual English and TOEIC 800 minimum   You are known for ✅ Your autonomy and sense of responsibility ✅ Your ability to solve problems in the field ✅ Your rigor and your sense of organization ✅ Your team spirit and constructive communication ✅ Your ability to be proactive in a rapidly changing environment

review_candidates.title: Partnerships, Webinars & Events Manager
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Partnerships, Webinars & Events Manager based in Brazil. As a Partnerships, Webinars & Events Manager, you will drive brand visibility, strategic partnerships, and lead generation across two complementary businesses: a growth marketing agency and an AI-powered commerce platform. You will own the end-to-end execution of webinars, corporate events, sponsorships, partner programs, co-marketing initiatives, and media outreach. Combining commercial strategy with hands-on production, you will develop sponsorship packages, secure revenue-generating partnerships, and deliver engaging experiences for industry audiences. You will collaborate with technology platforms, marketing partners, executives, speakers, and media professionals to expand reach and strengthen market positioning. Your work will directly support pipeline growth by turning audience engagement into qualified leads and measurable business opportunities. This fully remote role offers an international, fast-paced environment with close collaboration across teams operating in the Eastern Time Zone. The position also includes travel to New York for events, with all business communication conducted in English. Accountabilities Webinars and Content Programs: Plan and manage recurring webinars and lead-generation series across both brands, overseeing topic selection, guest sourcing, speaker preparation, promotional campaigns, run-of-show planning, live production, and post-event follow-up. Events and Production: Coordinate company-wide events, including office gatherings, founder dinners, brand activations, and conference participation. Manage the complete production process, from venue selection, audiovisual arrangements, and vendor coordination to on-site execution and post-event reporting. Sponsorship Development and Sales: Create compelling sponsorship packages for webinars and events, identify prospective sponsors, negotiate commercial agreements, and secure sponsorship revenue from brands, technology platforms, and strategic partners. Sponsor Relationship Management: Ensure sponsors receive the agreed deliverables, coordinate promotional commitments, and evaluate sponsorship outcomes to support long-term commercial relationships. Platform Partner Programs: Develop and manage partnership initiatives with advertising platforms, commerce providers, and marketing technology companies, including co-marketing opportunities and sponsorship packages for major industry events. Co-Marketing Campaigns: Build and maintain a pipeline of marketing technology, AI, and commerce partners, translating relationships into co-branded guides, joint webinars, shared promotional campaigns, and collaborative content initiatives. Partnership Execution: Coordinate partnership proposals, pitch materials, campaign deliverables, and distribution commitments, ensuring initiatives move from initial agreement to successful execution. Guest and Speaker Relations: Identify, approach, invite, and prepare guests for webinars, hosted content series, and podcasts, building relationships with relevant industry experts and thought leaders. Public Relations and Media Outreach: Pitch relevant stories to journalists and media outlets, secure executive appearances on external podcasts and panels, and identify speaking opportunities at industry conferences and events. Lead Generation and Performance Tracking: Ensure webinar registrants, event attendees, and other engaged audiences are captured in appropriate systems and receive timely follow-up, connecting each initiative to measurable lead-generation and business outcomes. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with marketing, leadership, and other internal stakeholders to align partnership and event programs with business objectives, brand positioning, and commercial priorities. Program Management and Optimization: Manage multiple initiatives, timelines, budgets, stakeholders, and deliverables simultaneously, using performance insights to improve future events, campaigns, and partnership programs. Requirements Three to five years of professional experience managing webinars, events, marketing partnerships, or related initiatives, ideally in a B2B environment with direct responsibility for lead generation. Demonstrated experience developing and selling sponsorship packages for events or webinars, including the ability to identify prospects, communicate value propositions, and secure commercial commitments. Proven hands-on experience producing events end to end, including run-of-show development, venue coordination, audiovisual arrangements, vendor management, on-site execution, and post-event follow-up.
